mutants.description: Compatible face-flux defect gets the wrong sign (interpolated gradient flux plus compact flux)
mutants.rationale: The defect operator is what keeps the collocated pressure and the face flux compatible; reversing it turns the damping into an anti-damping, so a steady solve must lose convergence or move the pressure field.

mutants.description: Compatible face-flux defect deleted: the compact two-point gradient is used as if it were a face flux
mutants.rationale: Deleting the interpolated-gradient part leaves an inconsistent face flux, i.e. exactly the checkerboard-prone operator this module exists to replace; the affine/consistency tests should notice.

mutants.description: Face skewness correction silently disabled regardless of the caller's flag
mutants.rationale: On skewed native meshes the skew term is the second-order part of the face reconstruction.  If no test uses a skewed mesh with the flag on, the defect survives and the suite only certifies orthogonal behaviour.

mutants.description: Owner/neighbour interpolation weights swapped in the affine-exact face reconstruction
mutants.note: 首次审计时该变异体 survived：被指向的 tests/test_native_mesh3d.py 只用单胞网格，没有内部面，权重路径从未被走到。已补 test_face_reconstruction_reduces_to_geometric_projection_on_nonuniform_pair 把存活项关闭。
mutants.rationale: With the weights swapped the geometric weight (which is not 1/2 on a graded mesh) inverts; any test that checks interpolation on a non-uniform mesh or affine reproduction must fail.

mutants.description: Gauss gradient returned as an integrated flux (cell volume division dropped)
mutants.rationale: The gradient is a per-volume quantity; dropping the division scales it by the cell volume.  Only a test that compares against an analytic affine gradient on cells of different volume can see it.
